title: File:Petar Vitanov in 2018.jpg
desc: Petar Vitanov (born March 19, 1967), nicknamed Patrika, is a former Bulgarian footballer who played as a midfielder and striker for CSKA Sofia.

title: File:2d Cav. Regt. vehicles arrive in Poti for Noble Partner (35369678174).jpg
art: U.S. Army Europe from Wiesbaden, Germany
desc: Cpl. Valeri Khursidze, a Georgian Military Policeman, stands guard as Neptune Okeanis crewmembers and port operations lower the ships door, July 27 in Poti, Georgia. The Neptune Okeanis cargo ship transported 2nd Cavalry Regiment troops and vehicles over the Black Sea from Burgas, Bulgaria.
